title: Independently review the prospective no-retry attempt policy
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Independently review the two-file prospective no-automatic-retry policy delivered by #682, accepted in iteration 0148 at cf0c84e5. Expected gain: a pinned CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR verdict on normative compatibility, deterministic scheduling/stopping and lossless accounting, with independent expected decisions and concrete counterexamples where needed. This closes only this design scope, never whole-method readiness or permission to execute. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] FIRST inspect .session/exports/manifest.json and input availability without opening author report/artifact contents, Markdown or schedule outcomes. Pin the actual starting commit/tree and the two policy file hashes. Inspect JSON top-level keys, then selectively read normative rules/preflight/integration definitions and governing sources without printing or opening schedules, demonstration outcomes, expectation_record or author checks. Derive your own finite synthetic schedules and expected inventory/completion/terminal decisions; save .session/artifacts/attempt-policy-independent-expectations-0149.json before reading any author worked outcomes, Markdown table, report or expectation artifacts. Record exposure and chronology honestly; normative rules are authored input, so claim independence of derivation only, not total blindness. If separation is accidentally lost, disclose it and preserve the initial artifact.
- [ ] Verify the target identities: benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.md SHA256 22c837604524677c06e0eaad9410018c1230ce86d0e6cfd767b8f3fcaaa79e39 and .json SHA256 15ccbdf618ad86cf477dc2f6a680ad8fdd146cf1ced060de6cd96f77eb9797df. Resolve cf0c84e5 to its full accepted commit/tree, check the actual changed scope and all declared source pins. Do not substitute the author's intermediate checkpoint for the accepted snapshot. A changed or unavailable target/input is a specific limitation, not clearance.
- [ ] Check normative rules against evaluation baseline requirements, unchanged 0143 envelope/0138 explicit repetition mapping, runner ordering, paired-plan stopping and existing precision design. Check finite predeclared order and immutable identities, settings/manifest/plan/freeze binding without circular hashes, no retries/substitution/favorable selection, evidence retention/quarantine, missing/unstarted coverage, and stop-versus-completion separation. Real configuration and trusted receipts must remain unavailable, benchmark_ready=false; no new counts, settings, quota, thresholds or owner acceptance. Scope F2 is already CLEAR: do not repeat its probes or broaden its caller boundary.
- [ ] Your independent cases must include intact pairs; either-arm ordinary failure; interrupted, unsupported, empty and invalid answers versus infrastructure/evidence failure; a failed attempt followed by successful extra; identical delivery with and without trusted no-second-execution proof; conflicting same-ID delivery and distinct-ID duplicates; early hard stop with later explicitly mapped repetitions whose arm labels differ; before/after-dispatch settings drift; initial and later resource exhaustion; simultaneous stop causes; and a late extra after an operational terminal state. Use the minimum finite examples needed and distinguish planned slots, authorized dispatches, retained attempts/deliveries, missing/unstarted/ineligible/unresolved slots, conditional structural completion and immutable terminal history. Real semantic credit stays zero. Derive facts from actual bytes; do not assert report counts as source facts.
- [ ] AFTER saving independent expectations, open author Markdown/JSON outcomes, exported report #682 and the three inputs, staged flat as .session/inputs/682-<name>. Check hashes against the export/input manifests and author's report. Compare independent decisions to normative rules and author applications; inspect expectation revision chronology and whether changes affect expected outcomes. Retain differences instead of rewriting initial expectations to agree. Distinguish author consistency from independent compatibility. Check that budget/usage, late audit changes, and duplicate delivery cannot silently improve completed-comparison accounting or erase missing evidence. Report any ambiguity as a finding with a minimal schedule and source/rule pointer.
- [ ] Write .session/report.md with scoped CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR, severity-ranked findings, actual commit/tree/file/source/input pins, chronology, verification and limitations; detailed evidence belongs only in .session/artifacts/. No repository edits, review file, implementation, integration, index promotion, new owner request or method acceptance. Do not invent a required finding. If CLEAR, explicitly close this scope; if NOT-CLEAR, name the narrow correction and changed-scope review needed. Actual admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and real comparisons remain zero.
## Verification
python3 -I -c "import hashlib,pathlib; pins={'benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.md':'22c837604524677c06e0eaad9410018c1230ce86d0e6cfd767b8f3fcaaa79e39','benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.json':'15ccbdf618ad86cf477dc2f6a680ad8fdd146cf1ced060de6cd96f77eb9797df'}; assert all(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in pins.items()); print('review targets unchanged: OK')"
This repository-only identity check does not validate the verdict. Within the session, validate your saved expectation/comparison artifacts and source pins using small direct Python checks; do not execute historical suites, product/benchmark code or the evaluator. Engine verification cannot access session artifacts.
## Context
The shaper read #682's report and the delivered Markdown, not the normative JSON or uploaded artifact bodies. #682 reports two additions, author consistency checks, preserved initial expectations and no execution; those are claims for this review to assess. The accepted iteration record reports cf0c84e5 and three artifacts. The supplement distinguishes delivery-only duplicates from extra provider attempts and late audit changes from immutable operational history, while keeping old multiple-attempt completion unresolved. These are substantive policy boundaries worth checking. Prior F1/F2 correction lineage is closed by #678 and is outside this review. Readiness still requires trusted resources/isolation, complete keys/probes/execution/scoring, whole-method independent review and owner acceptance.
## Budget
Initial reads: .session/exports/manifest.json and input availability metadata only; docs/perpetua/evaluation.md baseline/readiness; selected normative sections of benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.json; benchmark/attempt-evidence-0143.md accounting/controls; benchmark/project-run-binding-0138.json explicit plan/slot identities; benchmark/baseline/runner-contract.md ordering; benchmark/project-paired-0136.md stopping; benchmark/precision/README.md and selected policy/manifest_fields of plan.json; benchmark/baseline/run-manifest.template.json field identities. Save independent expectations before all later reads: benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.md, JSON schedules/demonstration/expectation_record, exported report #682, .session/inputs/682-attempt-policy-expectations-0148.json, .session/inputs/682-attempt-policy-expectations-0148.initial.json and .session/inputs/682-attempt-policy-design-checks-0148.json. Read selective objects, not whole large JSON or payload catalogs. At most two additional directly linked source sections for a concrete compatibility question; explain why. No keys, binary/hex payloads, broad history, closed reviewer suites, evaluator, transport/model requests, runner/scorer/probes/native execution or git commit. Keep command output short and report findings early.
